headline: Usiminas Shares Fall After Q3 Results Disappoint Market Expectations
summary: Usiminas shares dropped on the Ibovespa after reporting a third-quarter net profit of R$ 243 million, turning around from a R$ 3.5 billion loss in the same period of 2025, but coming in below market expectations.
why: Quarterly earnings reports that fall short of analyst expectations frequently cause immediate downward revisions in equity valuations and investor sentiment.
